description:
Conducted a detailed UX/UI review of the completed wireframes for Epics 1–4 with the project team. Analyzed feedback and identified required refinements to the authentication, OTP verification, account management, credit calculation, preliminary decision, and credit application flows.

Reviewed inconsistencies in the "Decision Ready" state, repeated vehicle information, incomplete application scenarios, error handling, and account blocking states. Discussed improvements to the main demo flow structure, navigation to detailed scenarios, and missing user flow branches.

Reviewed Figma comments, clarified design decisions, and identified open questions requiring further confirmation from the Business Analyst.

Epic / Feature: Epics 1–4 — Wireframe review and UX refinements
